question: In a write-through cache, what happens on a write?
options: Data is written to the cache and the backing store synchronously
Data is written only to the cache and flushed to the store later
Data is written only to the store, bypassing the cache
The cache entry is invalidated and rewritten on the next read
explanation: Write-through updates the cache and the backing store at the same time, keeping them consistent at the cost of write latency. Write-back defers the store update; write-around skips the cache on writes.
